item.title: Census Bureau plans to use survey with a citizenship question in its test for 2030, alarming experts
item.description: The U.S. Census Bureau plans to use a survey form with a citizenship question as part of its practice test of the 2030 census, raising questions about whether the Trump administration might try to make a significant change to the once-a-decade headcount that failed during the president’s first term.
